blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Amid continuing reports of harassment and government interference, the National Union of Journalists of the Philippines (NUJP) Cagayan de Oro Chapter has launched a campaign to protect media workers and push for local legislation safeguarding press freedom. To strengthen the campaign, the NUJP chapter urged local news outlets to report any press freedom violations they may have encountered. “Sending an email communication to Cagayan de Oro-based news outlets and journalists and urging them to report any press freedom violations is just one of our initiatives to strengthen the campaign, as we believe that there were unreported […]... Keep on reading: NUJP CDO launches drive to shield journalists
